title: Start of Delay Interest on a Late Entrance Fee Agreement Refund
content:
Where an **Entrance Fee Agreement** refund is paid after its refund due date, the interest days run from a start that depends on why the refund waited: where the estate's letters testamentary or of administration reached Larkspur 180 or more days after the refund due date, interest runs from 10 days after the letters were received; where they reached Larkspur 1 to 179 days after the due date, interest runs from the day the letters were received; otherwise interest runs from the refund due date; the days never fall below 0.

The interest days run from that start to the day the refund is paid. The day the letters were received is the date recorded on the agreement for the estate documents; the refund due date is the one fixed on the agreement.

## Start ladder

| Letters received, counted from the refund due date | Interest runs from |
|---|---|
| 180 or more days after | 10 days after the letters were received |
| 1 to 179 days after | The day the letters were received |
| On or before the due date, no letters, or a refund payable to the resident | The refund due date |

## Boundaries

| Days late of the letters | Start |
|---|---|
| 180 | Letters date plus 10 days |
| 179 | Letters date |
| 1 | Letters date |
| 0 | Refund due date |

## Hypothetical dates (refund due 1 March)

| Letters received | Days late | Interest from | Paid | Interest days |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 10 September | 193 | 20 September | 30 September | 10 |
| 1 April | 31 | 1 April | 30 April | 29 |
| 20 February | none | 1 March | 31 March | 30 |
| 10 September | 193 | 20 September | 15 September | 0 |
